common_contract.immutable_source: Pinned source hash, generated equivalent hash and accepted replacement approval must match; unchanged C runs and Ada equivalents remain separately labelled.
common_contract.configuration: Actual probe matches requested default/T; _soft and _port unset; T adapter available instrumented, absent default; same implementation children where applicable.
common_contract.process: exit0, no timeout/capture overflow/pipe drain/tree kill failures; 900second limit; complete process exit and retained stdout/stderr hashes.
common_contract.stderr: Exactly empty in both configurations: deliberate T warnings are stored and consumed in _WARN; any emitted warning is a failure.
common_contract.telemetry: schema1; run_id/process_id/configuration match; allocator_limit_bytes2147483648; outstanding_bytes0/outstanding_blocks0; Ada shutdown_complete true/accounting_fault false; C outer allocator must balance.
common_contract.default_gc_skip: Exactly the source omission text: >>> testC not active: skipping userdata GC tests <<<. This never covers T-only blocks13/14/17/21-24/26/28.
common_contract.default_gengc_skip: Exactly the source omission text: >>> testC not active: skipping some generational tests <<<, then OK and return. Blocks8-11 and exact T metadata12-15 need instrumented evidence.
common_contract.instrumented_skips: No testC-not-active or other skip/omission output allowed.
common_contract.gc_stdout: Require entry marker, steps, creating many objects, functions with errors, long strings, clearing tables, weak tables, long list, self-referenced threads, exact OK then later exact >>> closing state <<<. Instrumented additionally emergency collections and testing stack issues when calling finalizers.
common_contract.gengc_stdout: Require testing generational garbage collection and exact OK; instrumented additionally testing stop-the-world collection. Callback metatable output and source-reachable assertions remain reviewed paths, not arbitrary process success.

witness_class_rules.measured-storage-or-AUnit: Actual runtime measurement assertions and source-bound named AUnit evidence; aggregate case count insufficient.
witness_class_rules.warning-observed-callback: Warnings enabled before source; intentional store phases and exact _WARN assertions reviewed; unexpected warning negative tests must pass.
witness_class_rules.T-only: Instrumented actual adapter and no omission; default cannot promote this body.
witness_class_rules.Ada-equivalent-span: Accepted mapping and exact replacement span/hash plus named counterpart AUnit replay; never classify as unchanged execution.
witness_class_rules.dynamic-invocations: Execute every prescribed helper/loop/generated call including64parameter pairs and actual loaded chunks.
witness_class_rules.state-close: OK alone insufficient; later closing marker plus complete shutdown and allocator balance, with closure-order/count evidence below.
witness_class_rules.whole-file-semantic-audit: All child obligations resolved with per-context evidence and accepted crossreview; cannot promote via single process record.
witness_class_rules.source-path-assertions: Source/control-flow review plus full successful witness contract, without early return bypassing anchor.
